info.title: Bus Fleet API
info.description:
Multi-tenant group bus transportation platform REST API.

- **Authentication is owned by this API**: HS256 JWTs carry a custom `app_role` claim; refresh tokens rotate on every use and are stored hashed at rest.
- **Every response is wrapped in a `{ statusCode, data }` envelope**; the `data` schema is shown inside each documented response.
- **Fleet isolation is enforced by PostgreSQL RLS** as the final security boundary; cross-tenant lookups are indistinguishable from missing rows and return 404.
- `fleetId` path parameters are **selectors, never proof of authorization** — access is verified against the caller's ACTIVE `FleetMember` row on every request.
- Roles and permissions are **database-driven** (no hardcoded enums); only `super_admin` is a predefined system role. Platform routes (roles, permissions, users, fleets admin, audit-logs) are privileged: super admin only and audited.

tags.description: Login, rotating refresh tokens, logout, and the verified session identity.

tags.name: roles
tags.description: Platform role administration — privileged path, super admin only, audited.

tags.name: permissions
tags.description: Platform permission catalog administration — privileged path, audited.

tags.name: users
tags.description: Platform user administration — privileged path, audited.

tags.name: fleets
tags.description: Fleet administration (privileged) plus the caller's own memberships via `mine`.

tags.name: fleet-members
tags.description: Fleet membership management within a tenant fleet (tenant path).

tags.name: buses
tags.description: Fleet-owned bus CRUD — tenant path, RLS-enforced.

tags.name: trips
tags.description: Fleet-owned trip CRUD — tenant path, RLS-enforced.

tags.name: bookings
tags.description: Fleet-owned booking CRUD — tenant path, RLS-enforced.

tags.name: audit
tags.description: Platform audit log reads — privileged path, super admin only.

tags.name: passenger-auth
tags.description: Mobile passenger registration, OTP phone verification, and profile completion.

tags.name: passenger-trips
tags.description: Passenger trip search, station itineraries, and real-time seat inventory.

tags.name: passenger-bookings
tags.description: Passenger seat reservation, booking history, cancellation, and active trip tracking.

tags.name: routes
tags.description: Public QR route resolution and station itineraries.

tags.name: public-shares
tags.description: Public read-only live tracking share verification.

accessToken.description: HS256 access JWT carrying {sub, email, app_role, authVersion, sessionId}.

refreshToken.description: Opaque rotating refresh token (7 days). Present it to /auth/refresh; never store it client-side in localStorage.
The refresh token obtained from login/refresh. Single use — it rotates.

appRole.description: Global role slug resolved from the database (super_admin priority, "user" fallback).

authVersion.description: Bumped on security-sensitive changes; stale tokens are rejected.

sessionId.description: Session id — checked against live sessions on every request.

metadata.description: Structured, secret-free context (emails, slugs, permission keys…).

effectiveMaxBookingSeats.description: Display-only seat cap (user override ?? platform default 5). Enforcement is server-side.

ownerId.description: User id of the fleet owner (must exist and be active).

ownerRoleSlug.description: Optional initial ACTIVE membership for the owner.

roleSlug.description: Slug of the role held in this fleet.

vipTierId.description: VIP tier to assign; null clears the assignment.

userId.description: Target user — must exist and be active (else 404).

roleSlug.description: Role slug within this fleet; roleId takes precedence when both are given.

slug.description: Kebab-case unique slug used in JWT app_role and role APIs.

isSystem.description: System roles are protected from mutation/deletion.

permissionKeys.description: Full replacement permission set (atomic; unknown keys → 409).

maxBookingSeats.description: Per-user seat override; null means the platform default (5).

effectiveMaxBookingSeats.description: Effective per-booking seat limit (override ?? platform default).

authVersion.description: Bumped on security-sensitive changes; stale tokens rejected.

globalRoleSlugs.description: Global role slugs assigned at creation (unknown/inactive slugs → 409).

isActive.description: Deactivating bumps authVersion and revokes sessions.

maxBookingSeats.description: Per-user seat override (must be ≥ 1); null clears back to the platform default (5).

roleSlugs.description: Full replacement set of global role slugs. Removing the last active super admin → 409.

imageUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS URL of the bus image (Supabase Storage URL; bucket provisioning is a follow-up).

brandId.description: Admin-managed vehicle brand. Must be active.
Admin-managed vehicle brand. Must be active.

busId.description: Bus id — must belong to the same fleet (cross-fleet bus ids resolve to 404).

nickname.description: Passenger-facing familiar name for the fleet owner.

stopType.description: Stop capability; converted BOTH stations appear as an adjacent BOARDING + LANDING pair.
Stop capability; converted BOTH stations appear as an adjacent BOARDING + LANDING pair.

localityId.description: City/village locality for this stop. Must belong to the stop governorate.
City/village locality for this stop. Must belong to the stop governorate.

stopType.description: Whether passengers may board or land at this stop. Legacy BOTH rows remain readable but can no longer be written.

tripId.description: Trip id — must belong to the same fleet (cross-fleet trip ids resolve to 404).

promoStatus.description: Promo outcome echoed on create only.

boardingStationId.description: Boarding stop selected from this trip line.

landingStationId.description: Landing stop selected from this trip line.

pickupAddress.description: Passenger pickup address shown to the driver.

pickupLocationConfirmed.description: Passenger confirmed that the supplied current location is their pickup location.

confirmTimeConflict.description: Set to true to override a DUPLICATE_TIME_BOOKING conflict

bookingFor.description: Who travels: the booker or someone else.

passengerName.description: Required when bookingFor is OTHER; ignored for SELF (snapshot comes from the account).

note.description: Free-form note visible to the driver/operator.

promoCode.description: Promo code applied at checkout. Unknown/expired codes are ignored at full price; exhausted or already-used codes raise.

seatsToCancel.description: Number of seats to cancel. If omitted, all seats are cancelled.

reference.description: External transaction reference (e.g. Vodafone Cash / InstaPay transaction ID).

amount.description: Verified amount received. Must strictly equal the booking totalAmount.

notes.example: Verified in Vodafone Cash business account statement

reason.example: Transaction reference not found in merchant statement after 24 hours
reason.description: Reason for marking payment as failed.

notes.example: Attempted to contact passenger twice with no reply

refundAmount.description: Refund amount. Must not exceed the remaining unrefunded booking balance.

notes.example: Transferred via wallet to passenger mobile number

justification.example: Driver mobile battery died during trip

resolutionNote.example: Contacted passenger and clarified station pickup punctuality rule; incident resolved.

targetUserIds.description: Targeted user ids (platform responses only; empty for global codes).

type.description: FIXED only (fixed EGP amount, never percentage).

userId.description: Existing user id to invite (either userId or phone+name+password).

roleSlug.description: Role slug for the new membership (defaults to driver).

driverUserId.description: Driver user id (must hold an ACTIVE driver membership in the fleet).

fleetOwnerId.description: Owner user id — the grouping key.

vipRank.description: Best VIP rank across the owner fleets; null = untiered (sorts last).

busId.description: Owned-fleet bus to claim as the operating bus.

stationId.description: Station id — required when status is DROPPED_OFF.

reason.description: Reason — required when status is NOT_DROPPED_OFF.

method.description: Only cash is accepted on-device; the amount is read-only from the booking.

isTargetActive.description: False when the favorited fleet/bus was disabled after saving.

id.description: Omit to create; unknown ids are rejected, never auto-created.

entries.description: Full ordered list; array position wins.
